profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Information Technology Specialist with a demonstrated history of working in the military industry. Strong information technology professional skilled in Research, Microsoft Excel, Customer Service, Microsoft Word, and Microsoft PowerPoint.

positions.title: Information Technology System Administrator
positions.description: Designed and implemented robust system architectures to enhance software performance and scalability. Led cross-functional teams in developing innovative software solutions, improving project delivery timelines. Mentored junior engineers, fostering skill development and promoting best practices in software engineering. Spearheaded integration of modern development tools, increasing team efficiency and collaboration across projects. Analyzed system requirements and translated them into technical specifications for development teams. Maintained and optimized IT network infrastructure, including mainframes, mid-tier servers, and LAN/WAN systems, to support uninterrupted business operations. Achieved seamless implementation of complex IT systems through effective design and development. Drove contract management for maintenance and testing, enhancing system reliability. Delivered impactful support and redesign solutions for IT systems. Conducted training sessions and created resources to foster understanding of IT security and SDLC policies and standards among team members. Executed comprehensive database planning and design, leveraging data mining and warehousing methodologies for optimal performance. Analyzed and refined interactive databases and static web content, ensuring alignment with public reporting data requirements and database architecture. Configured and maintained network infrastructure, enhancing connectivity and system reliability for various units.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer and Information Systems Security/Information Assurance
